skill.name: bknd-password-reset
skill.description: Use when implementing password reset or change functionality in a Bknd application. Covers server-side password changes, building forgot-password flows with email tokens, and security considerations.

generated_query: I’m building a Bknd app with email/password authentication and I need to implement a “forgot password” flow. Users should be able to enter their email on a form, receive a one-time reset link (I’ll handle the email sending externally), and then set a new password. The reset token must expire after one hour and be usable only once. I also need an admin endpoint that can force-reset any user’s password by providing the user’s ID and a new password—this should hash the password properly, not store it in plain text. Can you help me write the server-side logic for token generation, validation, and the actual password change using Bknd’s auth module?
